extracted.intended_audience: sarcoma researchers and investigators seeking funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: A curated list of sarcoma-focused research funding opportunities, summarizing eligibility, award amounts, allowed uses, deadlines, and geographic or career-stage preferences to help researchers identify appropriate grants and application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: AACR-QuadW Foundation Sarcoma Research Fellowship — award amount and permitted uses
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a one-year grant of $60,000 to support the salary and benefits of the fellow while working on a mentored sarcoma research project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: "Funds may also be designated for nonpersonnel expenses, such as research/laboratory supplies, equipment, publication charges for manuscripts that pertain directly to the funded project, and other research expenses. However, grant funds cannot be used to compensate for clinical practice with patients or for indirect costs." Application deadline: January 9, 2025 (1:00 p.m. EST). Link to full program page provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: SFA Research Grants — scope and project types accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Invites Letters of Intent for research proposals for pre-clinical, translational, and clinical research on the etiology, molecular biology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and treatment of human sarcomas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports SFA mission to fund research and increase awareness/advocacy; goal is to encourage research that results in improved therapeutic options for sarcoma patients. "SFA encourages applications in ALL areas of sarcoma research." (LOI required; link to learn more provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: The Last Mile Sarcoma Research Award — award size, focus, and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides one-year grants of $150,000 to support translational science research on the etiology, molecular biology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and treatment of human sarcomas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Completed applications must be submitted by February 2, 2026, at 5:00 pm EDT. Goal aligned with improving therapeutic options for sarcoma patients. (Learn more link provided; explicit listing of many sarcoma subtypes targeted/eligible.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Summers Way / Friends of TJ Young Investigator Grant — career-stage eligibility and topic focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports scientists in the early stages of their careers, such as postdoctoral or clinical fellows; applicants must not have achieved an appointment higher than instructor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant program must have a focus on pediatric sarcoma. Deadline: December 30, 2024 (11:59 PM ET). (Link to application page provided; list of relevant sarcoma subtypes included.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Osteosarcoma Institute — program tracks and submission timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepting letters of intent for Clinical Trials, Correlative Science, Preclinical/Translational, and High-Risk/High-Impact grant programs in osteosarcoma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for submission: October 31, 2024. Off-cycle applications may be considered on a case-by-case basis. (Link to researchers/grants page provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Northwest Sarcoma Foundation — geographic preference and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepting proposals with a preference for investigators located in Alaska, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, and Washington.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for applications: October 15, 2024 (5:00pm PT). (Link to application information provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: MIB Agents Osteosarcoma Alliance — award types, amounts, and institutional location requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of intent for the OutSmarting Osteosarcoma Hero Award ($100,000/one year) and the OutSmarting Osteosarcoma Young Investigator Award ($50,000/one year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters of intent due by October 25, 2024 (11:59pm ET). "Awardees must be located at an institution within the US." (Link to program page provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Alan B. Slifka Foundation — funding limits and application cadence
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepting letters of intent on a rolling basis for research projects not exceeding $50,000 per year for up to two years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program described as the Sarcoma Research Grants Initiative; link to foundation biomedical grants page provided for more details and application instructions.
